shortDescription: Dispatch development tasks to local ZCode: worktree isolation, red-line review, git diff acceptance.
longDescription: Hand a well-specified development task to local ZCode (GLM). ZCode edits code in an isolated working copy (git worktree), model approval gates red-line changes, and git diff plus tests provide objective acceptance. Also supports deferred dispatch, session status checks, interrupting running turns, and answering pending approvals.
tryPrompts: Dispatch the login-page crash fix to zcode
Check where the zcode session is right now
